app.title: AIO – All-in-One
settings.title: Settings
help.display: If Chinese, Japanese or Hindi characters appear as boxes, your terminal font lacks those glyphs. In Termux, install a font with wide Unicode coverage via the Termux:Styling add-on, or copy a font to ~/.termux/font.ttf and run termux-reload-settings. Arabic and Hebrew are right-aligned; how letters are joined depends on your terminal.
tool.start_prompt: Press Enter to start, b to go back:
tool.error: The tool stopped with an error: {error}
picker.title: Choose your language
picker.hint: Number = choose · text = search · Enter = take the marked (*) language
picker.invalid: That number is not in the list.
tool.missing_program: The program "{name}" is missing. In Termux: pkg install {package}
update.done: AIO was updated to {version}. Restart aio to run the new version.
update.notice: An update is available ({new}: {subject}). Install it under Settings → Check for updates now.
update.mode_check: Check at start and let me know
update.mode_auto: Check at start and install automatically
update.error_no_source: No update folder found (~/.aio/src). AIO was not installed with aio-installer.sh. Run the install command from the README once; after that, updates work here.
update.error_no_git: git is missing. In Termux: pkg install git
update.error_network: Cannot reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again later.
update.error_install: The update could not be installed. Run the install command from the README again.
review.title: Review translations: {language}
review.source_language: {language} is a source language and written by hand. Choose another language to review its texts.
review.nothing: All texts in {language} have been reviewed. Thank you!

review.intro.one: {count} text has not been reviewed yet. For each one you see the English text and the current translation.
review.intro.other: {count} texts have not been reviewed yet. For each one you see the English text and the current translation.

review.status_missing: missing, English is shown for now
review.actions: Enter = fine · e = edit · s = skip · q = quit:
review.actions_missing: e = translate · Enter = skip · q = quit:
review.invalid: Not saved: placeholders must stay exactly as in the English text ({placeholders}).

review.summary.one: {count} text reviewed. Your corrections are in {path}.
review.summary.other: {count} texts reviewed. Your corrections are in {path}.

review.share_hint: Share this file, for example in a GitHub issue, so everyone benefits.
plugins.install_hint: Source: a folder, a .zip file or a git URL (e.g. https://github.com/name/aio-tool.git).
plugins.warning: Warning: a plugin is program code and runs with your permissions. Only install plugins from sources you trust.
plugins.error_source: Source not found or not readable: {source}
plugins.error_unsafe_zip: The .zip file contains unsafe paths and was not extracted.
plugins.error_no_manifest: No manifest.json found (neither in the folder nor in exactly one subfolder).
plugins.error_id: Invalid plugin id "{id}": use lower case letters, digits and _.
plugins.error_locales: Language files missing for: {langs}. Every plugin needs at least German and English.
doctor.title: System check
doctor.python_old: Python {version} is too old, 3.11 or newer is needed.
doctor.acoustid_missing: No AcoustID key. Create one for free at https://acoustid.org/new-application.
doctor.storage_missing: No access to phone storage. Run termux-setup-storage once.
doctor.key_rejected: AcoustID rejected the key, it was not saved.
doctor.key_saved_untested: AcoustID is not reachable right now. Key saved anyway, but untested.
